rows.sentence: According to the document, AI and machine learning in the financial industry serve several purposes.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly says that different parts of the financial services industry use AI and machine learning for various purposes.

rows.sentence: Building on earlier quantitative analysis models, AI/ML has been adopted to solve discrete challenges such as maximizing profit and minimizing risk.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document links AI/ML adoption to earlier quantitative analysis and gives both profit maximization and risk minimization as examples.

rows.sentence: Unlike older algorithms that automated human-coded rules, new AI models can "learn" by themselves and make inferences and recommendations not identified by modelers in advance.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly contrasts older rule-based algorithms with newer models that can learn and produce inferences and recommendations not specified in advance.

rows.sentence: This shift has also enabled the use of new data types—alternative data, unstructured data (such as images or social media posts), and unlabeled data—extending AI/ML to new financial services and products.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document lists all three data types, gives the same examples of unstructured data, and links their combined use to new financial offerings.

rows.sentence: Specific purposes include: powering chatbots in customer service; identifying investment opportunities and executing trades; augmenting lending models or, more sparingly, making lending decisions; and identifying and preventing fraud.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document lists each of these uses and specifically notes that making lending decisions is less common than augmenting lending models.

rows.sentence: More broadly, financial service providers adopt AI/ML to save time and money and to promote accessibility, accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document identifies these goals as reasons financial service providers are likely to continue adopting AI/ML; the sentence does not claim the goals have been achieved.

rows.sentence: The extent of adoption varies by sector and firm, reflecting factors such as a firm's ability to fund internal development and regulatory requirements.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document states that adoption varies across the industry and names internal funding capacity and regulatory requirements as factors.
